{{Quote|Warusman Ordo is dead! We-I-we followed him and saw... it was because of the poison. The Sand People got him!''"<br />"''Then he is not the best.|Warusman Ordo's epiphany|<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Warusman Ordo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Along with fellow Mandalorians [[Pit Rauhut]] and [[Roggar Den]], he came to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to participate in a challenging trial. One would inject himself with lethal poison and have approximately 30 minutes to acquire the antidote from extremely hostile [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] nearby. Warusman Ordo was trying to prove himself the best, but in the end, the poison weakened him enough for the Sand People to finish him.
